items.summary: Dollar Tree, Inc. (NASDAQ:DLTR) reported fiscal second-quarter net sales of $4.9 billion, an increase of 7.0% from a year earlier. Comparable-store net sales grew 3.7% on top of 6.5% growth in the prior-year quarter.
